content: If the CR timer ( FrArTpTimeoutCr ) expires, the receiver shall send an AF with negative acknowledgement and the sequence number of the missed CF. This shall be done up to FrArTpMaxRn times. After that, the transmission shall be aborted , and within PduR_ FrArTp RxIndication, the result E_NOT_OK shall be returned. If previously in t he current block a sequence error oc c urred, this error shall be reported at the block end in PduR_ FrArTp RxIndication .
